content: Award Data and Resources Sept. 15, 2025 At a glance Learn more about CDC's grants and cooperative agreements award data resources. Award Data Federal law requires award data to be publicly available. Below are several resources that provide information on CDC grants and cooperative agreements award data. Resource Available Award Data Tracking Accountability in Government Grants System (TAGGS) Provides information on grants awarded by the eleven HHS Operating Divisions (OPDIVs), included CDC. USA Spending Provides information about federal awards such as contracts, grants, and loans. Information for each federal award includes: The name of the entity receiving the award The amount of the award Information on the award such as transaction type and funding agency The location of the entity receiving the award A unique identifier of the entity receiving the award Site required by the Federal Funding Accountability and Transparency Act (FFATA), 2006 CDC Funding Profiles Provides interactive data and summaries of CDC cooperative agreement and grant funding to recipients in U.S. states and territories, and the District of Columbia, starting with fiscal year (FY) 2010. Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) Process The Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) is a law that gives the general public the right to access information from the federal government. All records in CDC's possession and not already in the public domain are subject to FOIA. To make a FOIA request, visit the CDC FOIA website .
